scope: Offline compatibility and refusal checks on a retained actual version3 metadata-expiry journal, using synthetic signed observer assertions; no fresh RPC or independent-node observations
checks: Retained actual version3 metadata redemption is inspectable as expired with original code/mint review and historical expiry checkpoint
Matching retained code pins and three synthetic review signatures produce only a review packet with every recovery and production flag disabled
Otherwise valid synthetic signatures cannot substitute a caller-selected code hash for the actual retained metadata journal pins
A signed report with another journal hash cannot inherit the retained metadata review binding
Synthetic late-settlement, missing-history and lost-liability assertions refuse rather than approve expiry recovery
Original journal and selected private inputs remain unchanged; no RPC, validator, signing handoff, transaction, retry or refund was performed
excludedFromPublicRecord: Private journal IDs, addresses, signatures and review packets
Synthetic observer identities, signed assertions and private input digests
Raw journals, private keys, signed transaction bytes, balances and logs
